title: Best man
logline: Gully marries Maria. Wood is best man. The strip cuts before the speech.

panels.composition: Gully's dock, June, strung with lights, folding chairs, the whole town. GULLY in a borrowed jacket over the apron — no, no apron, the one day. MARIA in a plain dress, practical shoes. A county judge. WOOD beside Gully in the thrift-store wool suit. BARNABY as ring bearer, sort of.

panels.composition: Gully, to Wood, sideways, during the vows.

panels.composition: Wide, from the water. The dock. The lights. The whole town at the tables. A small figure standing with a glass. The strip cuts here. Whatever he said is the town's.
